description: This file is a minified JavaScript library for network visualization, specifically the 'vis.js' library version 4.17.0. It provides dynamic, browser-based visualization functionalities, including utilities, DOM manipulation, datasets, networking, and visualization parsers. The code contains initialization logic and module definitions for the vis.js library which is used in web projects for visualization purposes.

classes.name: DataSet
classes.description: A class for managing a dataset of items, supporting operations like add, update, remove, and get, used internally and externally in visualization processes.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A class that manages the network visualization including nodes, edges, physics, and interaction handling.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: A base class for visual shapes in the network, providing methods for drawing, resizing, and border detection.

classes.name: CircleShape
classes.description: A class representing a circle shape used in nodes or edges, with methods to draw and compute border distances.

classes.name: DiamondShape
classes.description: A class representing a diamond shape used in nodes or edges, with methods to draw and compute border distances.

classes.name: SquareShape
classes.description: A class representing a square shape, with drawing and border distance computation.

classes.name: TriangleShape
classes.description: A class for triangle shapes, with drawing and border detection.

classes.name: StarShape
classes.description: A star-shaped shape class, with methods for rendering and calculating proximity.

classes.name: IconShape
classes.description: A shape class that renders icon characters, with size, font, and label drawing capabilities.

classes.name: ImageShape
classes.description: A shape class that renders images within nodes, supports border styling and label drawing.

classes.name: BezierEdge
classes.description: A class for edges with bezier curves, capable of calculating points along the curve, border positions, and rendering smooth connections.

methods.name: convertDot
methods.description: Converts DOT language graphs into vis.js graph data structures.

methods.name: convertGephi
methods.description: Converts Gephi graph data into vis.js compatible format.
